limits: Development verification is not independent audit approval. I-4.2 is not approved.
Host memory RPC/scope/key execution and MEM-10 are deferred to separately approved I-4.2; existing Runtime/Host regressions do not establish memory execution.
Local synthetic provider/accounts; no commercial API, real user key or authenticated Chat sync.
Host counts are included in workspace; extra platform tests counted separately.
macOS Rust does not verify iOS Simulator, Archive, device, GUI or formal CLI.
SQLite files are OS-protected plaintext; no E2EE or protection against the local OS owner/admin.
